chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah and al-Ḥimyarī, both together, from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār, from his brother ʿAlī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, who said:

Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī was taken, and he was twenty-five years, three months, and twelve days old. He passed away on Tuesday, with six days having passed from Dhū al-Ḥijjah, in the year two hundred and twenty. He lived after his father for nineteen years, less twenty-five days.

key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: he died; indicating the time of death
key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: Dhū al-Ḥijjah, the twelfth month of the Islamic calendar
key_terms.عَاشَ بَعْدَ أَبِيهِ: he lived after his father; indicating the duration after his father’s passing
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, the Imam being described

ai.seo_question: When did Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the age, date of death, and length of the Imamate period after the father of Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام. It serves as a brief biographical notice preserving chronological details about the life of the Imam عليه السلام in the hadith tradition.
